evidence: Defining behaviour graded: the brief's core is a shared pipeline board with stage rules, concurrency safety and live updates, plus conversations. Functional criteria grade it directly and heavily: hro_move_one_stage (1.5), hro_stale_refused (2.5, 409 out-of-date move names who changed it), hro_bulk_move/hro_bulk_all_or_none/hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_restores/hro_undo_conflict (2 each), hro_live_board (2.5), hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen, hro_thread_latest/earlier; polish hro_pol_live_board/hro_pol_live_thread (3 each) grade the 'nobody's work gets trampled' preservation promise. Server-backed, not same-origin: gates/constraints hro_gate_shared requires the job+candidate created through UI by Rafael to be read by the Observer in a NEW browser context (browser().newContext()), and explicitly says 'a browser-only save ... does not satisfy the gate'; the same check is restated as the in-dimension gate in all three scored prompts. Shared state is repeatedly read from independent contexts of other people: hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_arrive_bottom, hro_reorder ('the new order is what an independent context of another recruiter sees', matching rules 'same for everyone'), hro_bulk_move, hro_undo_restores (Mei Lin independent context), hro_unread_counts (Mei's per-person count in her own session), hro_seen and hro_msg_exchange (Tomas independent context), hro_activity (Observer independent context). Nothing requires same-origin; app_context and prompts allow any routes. Restart durability: functional hro_restart (weight 1.5), protocol D last, calls the verifier restart_app tool once (test.sh lines 127-193 relaunch node on the same __APP_DB__ via setpriv; restart_mcp.py single-use marker reset at line 192), then a fresh sign-in, and requires jobs, card order per stage, notes, messages, unread counts (thus read markers) and activity lines unchanged, the seeded Platform Engineer order and Noor's seeded note (pre-read in Z) intact and no re-seeding; 'A reload is not a restart; if restart_app reports an error ... hro_restart is 0'. This mirrors the frozen template's persistence criterion and covers the brief's 'keep new work across restarts' and rules s3 'Order survives a reload, a fresh sign-in and a restart'. Re-auth durability: brief and rules s6 require an unsent reply to survive switching, reload and the session ending, return to the same person after re-sign-in, and be invisible to anyone else signing in on that browser; rules s3 the same for unsaved notes. hro_drafts covers switch/reload per conversation; polish hro_pol_session_resume (2.5) ends the session from a second tab, requires a sign-in prompt and nothing sent, the same reply restored and sendable after sign-in (positive control), then reply and note drafts empty for Mei Lin and restored for Rafael after Mei's visit. hro_msg_compose checks a sent message is not resurrected after reload. Weak apps considered: an in-memory or wipe-and-reseed-on-boot server passes the gate but fails hro_restart (J1/J2 lost or seeded read markers/unread counts reset); a localStorage-only board fails the independent-context gate (score 0); drafts in unkeyed localStorage fail the Mei leg; drafts in sessionStorage or memory fail reload/re-auth legs; an app re-seeding duplicates fails 'not loaded again'. Conforming alternatives considered: drafts kept server-side per user, in per-user localStorage, or in IndexedDB all pass ('Where drafts are kept is yours'); polling, SSE or sockets all pass; any route layout passes. Scored suites run sequentially (rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1, test.sh line 207), so polish activity cannot disturb the D before/after comparison. Runtime: scripted golden evidence (hashes verified against the index and frozen sources) shows the reference passes the corresponding observations: results[23] 'restart keeps jobs, cards, order, messages, unread counts and activity without reseeding; live updates resume' via real SIGTERM + relaunch on the same DB_PATH with cwd /tmp (workspace.cjs 15-19, 519-522), results[21] session-ended draft resume and other-person isolation, results[19] per-conversation drafts across switch and reload, results[17] live board with note draft surviving reload. Risk remains true because no full configured judge run exists for this candidate (raw-evidence-index scope: 'Full configured grading/workload ... and Oracle/target scores are absent'); hro_restart sits at the end of a very long functional protocol with a 9000 s judge timeout, so budget exhaustion would record the durability row as NOT EXERCISED 0, and whether the configured judge actually executes restart_app, the independent contexts and the session-end flow is unmeasured. Minor notes (not defects): seen marks are not explicitly listed in the restart comparison (messages and unread counts are); unsaved note drafts are proven across sign-out/sign-in rather than a separate reload, which is the stronger condition.
run_verdict: PARTIAL - scripted golden observations confirm the reference satisfies restart, independent-context, reload and session-resume legs; no configured judge run has exercised hro_restart, hro_gate_shared or hro_pol_session_resume on this candidate
